messages.content: 誰是目前排名第一的網球選手？

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have up‑to‑date information on the current world No 1 tennis player at this very moment. Rankings fluctuate weekly based on tournament results, so the best way to get the latest standings is to visit:

* **ATP** – [https://www.atptour.com](https://www.atptour.com)  
* **WTA** – [https://www.wtatennis.com](https://www.wtatennis.com)

These sites list the most recent singles rankings for men’s and women’s tours respectively.
message.reasoning:
The user asks "Who is currently ranked first tennis player?" They want ranking info. We have tool `sports_team_standing` but that's for teams and leagues; we need individual players. There's no direct tool. So we cannot answer with certainty. According to policy, if uncertain or can't find data, respond with uncertainty.

We can say: I don't know exactly who is top-ranked right now because rankings change frequently. Provide general guidance: check ATP/WTA official sites. Also mention last known as of my knowledge cut-off (Nov 2023). But better to express uncertainty.

Thus produce an apology and explain inability due to lack of real-time data.
